held_out_policy: Choose the default on development before any held-out ranking. Do not tune on held-out failures or change frozen gold to hide a failure.
limits: Small three-article agent-authored software pilot; not clinical validation.
Question-level split shares documents and some passages; no document-level generalization claim.
Non-exhaustive support labels may omit alternative valid passages.
No established multiple-report study; multi-passage questions do not validate cross-report retrieval.
no_answer_policy: Report nonempty-candidate rate, scores and retrieved context/limitation spans separately. Candidate passages do not assert an answer, entailment, absence of evidence, or verification.
scoring_contract: docs/project-retrieval-milestone.md: Candidate preparation, fixed before ranking
support_semantics: OR sufficient-support alternatives; AND passages within a set. A passage is covered when every question-specific required quote is contained in returned exact windows for its same source/block. Best alternative coverage is the per-question maximum.
